notes.title: Small distribution update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We are very happy to finally get full control of the publishing rights of Flat Heroes. After a lot of discussing we have decided to bring the price of our game on par with other platforms (9.99$). We think that the new price will still be very fair for the scope of Flat Heroes and it will give us a tiny bit more room to work on projects to come.

The adjusted price will come into effect earliest August 1st 2019. We wanted to give you a quick shout about this upfront so you still have the chance to buy the game at the current price if you want to.

Thank you so much!

notes.title: Small Update: Launch Options!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

After reading some feedback from the community, we made a small update to add a few launch options (to enable them go to Steam, right click on Flat Heroes > "Properties" > "Set Launch Options", and write the commands you want to use, without the ' ):

'[b]-disableGeometryShaders[/b]' : use it to go back to the more "flat" version, we prefer the new and improved style, but we won't judge you if you want the old one back :) - [NOTE: this is automatically enabled on low-end PCs]

'[b]-show-screen-selector[/b]' : to see the launcher that lets you change the resolution and Graphics Quality

'[b]-mouseButtonSupport[/b]' : a few users wanted the old mouse+keyboard control (where you attacked with the mouse), use this if you want the old controls back.

If there are any issues, you can find us in the forums! :)

notes.title: Survival Mode, Twitch, Demo & Nintendo Switch!
notes.content:
Dear Community!

Well, where to start? First of all: Thanks for your patience. We know, it has been a while since we gave you some new stuff for Flat Heroes. It has been a while, since we kept you up to date. And we're sorry. But there have been really, really, really (like REALLY) good reasons for that. And today we can finally talk about what has happened recently.

First of all we would like to announce the release of an all new update today. Which comes along with lots of new features and lots of new content. So, what is new?

[h1]Survival Mode[/h1]
We have now included an all new survival mode. There are several levels available where you can try to survive as long as possible. We've got highscores, we've got plenty of challenges and heck, you can even tweet your scores right from within the game. And it creates cool gifs for Twitter, too!

[h1]Twitch Integration[/h1]
That was tricky to include but we finally managed to do so. Yes, Flat Heroes now features Twitch integration. So if you have a Twitch channel and want to interact with your community, you can do that. It is a twist of the survival mode. And once you gave the game the needed infos, your viewers can vote on what should happen next in the level. And there's an exclusive leaderboard for Twitchers, too!

[h1]Demo[/h1]
Of course, there's lots of other stuff. We've been tweaking and fixing days and nights. And Flat Heroes should now be even better. But you are still insecure, right? You still don't know for sure if you should buy it, right? Well! We've got a solution for that. There is now a demo available for Flat Heroes. Currently the demo can be found on Gamejolt and Itch.io. It will soon be up on Steam, too.

http://gamejolt.com/games/FlatHeroes/255033
https://flatheroes.itch.io/flat-heroes

[h1]Nintendo Switch![/h1]
Yes. That's right. Flat Heroes is coming to Nintendo Switch. It's official now. And that is an incredible feeling. When? Somewhen. No date confirmed yet. But we can finally speak about it.

notes.title: Flat Heroes is embracing the future with Comic Sans!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25940803/07cd14076d3bc1c83ef532e61bdfaff8bbd98bb6.gif[/img]

Flat Heroes, as a widely know game for its visual style based on the latest graphic design tendencies is moving forward to meet Comic Sans: the new trendy font of our era.

Flat Heroes has always been trying to be at the forefront of the graphic design tendencies following several visual style trends, such as flat design or material design. Now it's preparing to go ahead in this stream adopting the late 90s trendy experience: Comic Sans. With this move the company expects to be ready to match the top cutting-edge visual tendencies when Flat Heroes comes out of Early Access.

[h1] The first iteration with the new art style has passed all internal quality test and will be available to all our Steam players tomorrow 1st of April. [/h1] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25940803/84bafd6d1c0d619001f0fc289c7e1f87aff52e46.gif[/img]

[i]"The first windows logo and current one (10) have a similar style. In graphic design, as in many other arts, trends are cyclic"[/i] explains Lucas Gonzalez, visual artist of the project, [i]"It's a matter of time that Comic Sans comes back stronger than ever, and then we will be ready"[/i].

Despite of the hate from the graphic designers establishment, Comic Sans was a revolution of its era. Initially designed for comic speech bubbles, the font quick broke these barriers and started expanding in any context of the society, from public services to police reports or commercial adverts or even sport trophies. Its simple and friendly style helps to communicate a clear message in a nice educated manner, allowing this font to replace other unfashionable options like Helvetica on the career for the perfect design.

But Parallel Circles doesn't stop there. Roger Valldeperas, main tool programmer in Flat Heroes, is working on a tool to integrate WordArt in the game engine:
[i]"The idea was to implement a tool that allowed us to create a wide and fancy range of visual experiences. When we asked ourselves that question the answer was clear: WordArt".[/i]


[b]As always let us know your thoughts and suggestions, and get ready to play with the new style, starting tomorrow. April 1st ! [/b]

notes.title: New update v0.48 is live!!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[h1]Today there's a new Flat Heroes update (v0.48)![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25940803/0004e90055da9d933e06ed78f9a920e30d8f6086.gif[/img]

We've been working on the difficulty curve to make it a bit more smooth, and this update also adds a new world and brings some new enemies to the waves mode. It's a great opportunity to revisit the adventure again!

We also updated the player's movement set to add some more depth and give players more options in each situation, so there are new and more exciting ways to beat some levels now! And we reworked the charging and shooting mechanics for the versus modes, which should make it more viable to use in combats.

And you may also find lots of small changes that we've been doing to polish the game further :)

[b]Here are the update notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Final Boss! Currently on world 6, let us know what you think!
[*] New enemy inspired by some retro game (guess which one!), but of course a bit more intense 
[*] New enemy based on beehives... but of course more intense?
[*] Added new levels, reaching 7 levels now!
[*] New and reworked level progression, with a 200% better difficulty curve*
[*] New charge-shooting mechanic for versus battles: now 200% more trepidant
[*] New secret and deeper player movements: dash dash dash!
[*] New juicy animations
[*] Automatic quality adjustment, 60 fps is a right, not a privilege
[*] Extra gamefeel bits all around the game, including:
        > updated initial countdown
        > walls that kill should be a bit more clear now
        > on runner it should be more when the runner changes and who is the new one
	> new end of match effect on some versus modes
[*] Optimizations and bug fixes here and there
[/list]
* based on internal studies and magic spells.

If you find any issue or have any suggestion feel free to join us on the game's Steam discussions.
Still, this is not the big update we're going to make soon-ish, we're still working on that one!

Oh, and [b]Flat Heroes has been recently nominated to the SXSW Gamer's Voice awards[/b] in Texas! :D
[url=https://gaming.sxsw.com/news/2017/gamers-voice-nominees-revealed-sxsw-gaming-2017/]Check out the nominees![/url] 

Enjoy!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25940803/852d0b87f647544388c0bcc494f6645ea6a22e9a.gif[/img]


[i]PS: sorry for those who were doing a let's play series, we had to reorder and add many levels.
PS2: ICYMI the game is now cheaper during Early Access, take a look at the previous [url=http://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791455462211/announcements/detail/254854514747085979]announcement[/url] for more details![/i]

notes.title: We're updating the price!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Sorry for the long silence, we've been really busy behind the scenes getting stuff ready and discussing our future plans.

And today there's an important announcement to make!

[h1]We are updating the price of Flat Heroes during Early Access to $7.99 (check Steam after the change for the equivalence on other currencies).[/h1]

We think the game features enough content and quality to have the current price, but we also understand that it is a barrier for many, especially because of the awesome but minimalist style of the game. With the new price we hope more people will consider buying the game and join us on our Early Access adventure!

For those who have bought the game less than 2 weeks ago and are not happy with the price they paid, you should be able to get a refund from Steam and buy it again at the lower price if you wish.

And for anyone who bought the game before the price change, send us an e-mail to 'contact (at) parallelcircles.com' and we'll give you [b]something awesome[/b] to thank you for your early support! :)


Also, there's an update coming later this week, stay tuned!

We'll soon have more exciting news!

Parallel Circles

notes.title: New patch v0.46 is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25940803/e037995ea37e4fc8467e10f23ac261eee3f398bd.gif[/img]

Hi everyone!

In this update we have focused on continuing to polish small details to make the game feel better, i.e. now a subtle slow-mo happens if the last enemy of a wave is killed by a player, adding up a bit of excitement when you complete a hard level! 

We also added our first boss intro! The World 5 Boss now has an intro the first time you encounter it, intros for the rest of the bosses will be added on future updates.

Another change introduced is a gentle push to player's attack, player attacks will now push away nearby players a little bit in cooperative modes. This is to avoid "turtle formations" (multiple players really close to each other attacking non-stop). We've seen some players use this strategy on advanced levels and they don't learn what they must learn in order to progress on further levels. It's also in preparation to the addition of teams, where this strategy would lead to really boring matches. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25940803/129fae87908b12706a90055268f8e27043d26f90.gif[/img]

[h1] Patch notes [/h1] 

- Player's attack now gently pushes surrounding players if they are too close, to avoid turtle formations
- Added slow-mo on the last enemy of waves levels if that enemy is killed by a player
- World 5 Boss now has an intro, we'll be adding other boss intros on future updates
- World 5 Boss now has some extra screen-shakes and gamepad rumbles!
- Added Parallel Circles logo
- Fixed issue where the pick-up could not be attacked during the first half a second in catch
- On catch players' rotation is also reset at the end of each mini-round to avoid some weird jumps
- Small fix on button text
- Minor optimizations on memory usage
- Added more vibration events

notes.content:

We had a really busy week with EGX and some other secret stuff but here's the new update!

If there's any new ideas or suggestions you'd like to tell us feel free to join the Steam discussions!

notes.title: Flat Heroes Release Date announced (Early Access, September 8)
notes.content:
We're really excited to announce the release date of Flat Heroes on Steam!
And we've got a new trailer to announce the Early Access launch!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZgdtKS6GWTE

[h1]Flat Heroes will be available in Early Access on Steam on September 8th, 2016 for Windows, Mac and Linux! That's next week!![/h1]

From launch the game will include a solo/co-op mode (1-4 players) with around 90 levels and 6 final bosses, and 4 competitive modes for up to 4 players that will also include bots to play against.

We have lots of ideas we'd like to implement, but we want to make sure we're going to the right direction while allowing players to shape the game.
So during Early Access we plan to work with the community and let you choose the kind of content you would like to see in the game (being solo player modes, more co-op modes/levels, more competitive modes, or who knows!) to make Flat Heroes an even bigger and better experience for everyone!

Stay tuned!
